lead_raw_text:
The trigonal structure of Zn12Ni3 (reduced formula Zn4Ni) crystallizes in space group R-3m (No. 166), with 15 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ni centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 Zn neighbors, while Zn centers show 11- or 12-neighbor environments, including a Zn-only 12-neighbor coordination. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 15 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 11- and 12-vertex Zn polyhedra.
